_comment: The App Privacy answers (the 'nutrition label'). App Store Connect has no API for them: entered once by hand under App Privacy, from this file. They follow PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy and https://trommi.com/privacy. End-to-end encrypted content the operator cannot read is not 'collected' in Apple's sense and is not listed.

collected.why: the account id (printed on the Emergency Kit) and the devices' public keys

not_collected: Diagnostics (no SDK; Apple's own crash reports are not declared)
User Content (end-to-end encrypted, unreadable to the operator)
Device ID (no advertising or vendor id is sent)
